    --eevenkoto-field-input-bg,
    var(--eevenkoto-color-form-input-background)
  );
  --_eevenkoto-field-input-text: var(
    --eevenkoto-field-input-text,

    --eevenkoto-field-input-border-color,
    var(--eevenkoto-color-form-input-border)
  );

  box-sizing: border-box;

  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  line-height: 1.25;

    var(--eevenkoto-color-form-input-border-invalid)
  );
}

.eevenkoto-field__message {
  font-size: 0.75rem;

}

}

## Planned CI verification & linting rules

These AST-based Stylelint checks are the **intended** guardrails for `packages/css/core/**/*.css` and `packages/css/domain/**/*.css`. They are **not enforced in CI yet** — treat them as authoring requirements until plugins ship.

```text
                    Pull Request / Code Commit
                                │
                                ▼
         ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
         │       Check 1: Primitive Prefix Check        │
         │  Does file contain hue-primitive leakage?    │
         └──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                                │ NO
                                ▼
         ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
         │          Check 2: Raw Color Literals         │
         │ Does file contain #hex, rgb(), or oklch()?   │
         └──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                                │ NO
                                ▼
         ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
         │     Check 3: Direct Tier 2 in Property       │
         │  Is CSS property set to var(--eevenkoto-color│
         │        WITHOUT a private bridge (--_)?       │
         └──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                                │ NO
                                ▼
         ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
         │     Check 4: Cyclic Dependency Detection     │
         │   Is a public token assigned to itself?      │
         └──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                                │ NO
                                ▼
                     [CI VALIDATION PASSED]
```

1. **Strict Tier 1 Boundary Guard** (`eevenkoto/no-primitive-in-components`) — Rejects hue-primitive references inside `packages/css/core/` and `packages/css/domain/`.
2. **Raw Literal Guard** (`eevenkoto/no-raw-color-literals`) — Rejects raw hex, `rgb()`, `hsl()`, or `oklch()` literals within component stylesheets.
3. **Bridge Enforcement** (`eevenkoto/enforce-private-bridge`) — Flags component CSS that consumes a Tier 2 token without establishing the private `--_eevenkoto-` bridge fallback pattern.
4. **Cyclic Invalidation Guard** (`eevenkoto/no-self-referencing-vars`) — Flags assignments where a public token references itself without a separate private variable.

```css
/* CI FAILS THIS: Cyclic invalidation (IACVT) */
--eevenkoto-button-bg: var(--eevenkoto-button-bg, red);

/* CI PASSES THIS: Distinct private variable */
--_eevenkoto-button-bg: var(--eevenkoto-button-bg, red);
```
## Component taxonomy

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/foundations/component-taxonomy.mdx`_

# Component taxonomy

Eevenkoto organizes UI on **two axes**:

1. **Reuse scope** — **Core** (product-agnostic chrome) vs **Domain** (Eevenkoto content vocabulary: creatures, abilities, statblocks).
2. **Composition level** — Atomic Design: **Atoms → Molecules → Organisms**. Templates and Pages are reserved for later full-page demos.

Also read: [Glossary](/?path=/docs/foundations-glossary--docs) · [Packages](/?path=/docs/foundations-packages--docs) · [Authoring composed components](/?path=/docs/foundations-authoring-composed-components--docs)

## Why both axes

Atomic levels answer “how complex is this?” They do **not** answer “is this reusable chrome or creature content?” Core vs Domain keeps Button and Heading from looking interchangeable with Statblock in the sidebar and in source layout.

| Scope | Meaning | Examples |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Core** | Portable building blocks; English APIs; no RPG vocabulary required | Button, Badge, Heading, Property, List, Stat, Flow, Table, TableShell |
| **Domain** | Content patterns for this product family; may compose Core freely | AbilityScore, StatblockFeature, Statblock |

## Composition levels

| Level | Owns | Core examples | Domain examples |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Atom** | One semantic unit + BEM classes | Button, Badge, Heading, Paragraph, Caption, Property, ListItem, Stat, Frame, Scroll, TableCell | — |
| **Molecule** | Layout of atoms + local ARIA | Flow, Prose, PropertyList, List, Table | AbilityScore, StatblockFeature, StatblockSection |
| **Organism** | Page-shaped composition, slots, outline | TableShell | AbilityScoreGroup, Statblock |

Prop and file naming: see [Glossary](/?path=/docs/foundations-glossary--docs).

## Dependency rule

**Domain may import Core. Core must never import Domain.**

Promote a Domain piece into Core only when reuse is proven across unrelated contexts — never because one screen needs it.

## Source layout

Package source mirrors the taxonomy (`core/atoms/…`, `domain/organisms/…`) while root barrels (`@eevenkoto/html`, `@eevenkoto/react`, …) keep a stable public export surface.

Storybook titles follow the same paths: `Core/Atoms/Button`, `Domain/Organisms/Statblock`.
## Glossary

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/foundations/glossary.mdx`_

# Glossary

Canonical vocabulary for Eevenkoto APIs, source layout, and docs. Prefer these names in props, types, file paths, and prose.

Also read: [Component taxonomy](/?path=/docs/foundations-component-taxonomy--docs) · [Authoring composed components](/?path=/docs/foundations-authoring-composed-components--docs) · [Minimum-class defaults](/?path=/docs/foundations-minimum-class-defaults--docs) · [Packages](/?path=/docs/foundations-packages--docs)

## Locale policy

- **Public APIs are English** (prop names, type names, BEM blocks, defaults).
- **Product-language strings are data** — Finnish (or any locale) belongs in story / app props, not in `@eevenkoto/core`.
- English defaults (`Score`, `Modifier`, `Save`, `proficient`) may ship for AT labels; override them when the surrounding UI is localized (`scoreLabel`, `modifierLabel`, `saveLabel`, `proficientLabel`).

## Architecture terms

| Term | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| **Core** | Product-agnostic chrome; no RPG vocabulary required |
| **Domain** | Eevenkoto content patterns (creatures, abilities, statblocks); may compose Core |
| **Atom** | One semantic unit + BEM classes |
| **Molecule** | Layout of atoms + local ARIA |
| **Organism** | Page-shaped composition, slots, outline |
| **Tier 1 / 2 / 3** | Token layers: primitives → semantics → component bridges |
| **Host default** | `.eevenkoto-<block>` alone = documented default look; see [Minimum-class defaults](/?path=/docs/foundations-minimum-class-defaults--docs) |
| **Prose** | Scope for bare `h1`–`h6` / `p` / `ul` / `ol` / `li` type styles (compose with Flow for rhythm) |
| **Flow** | Vertical rhythm for stacked type (classed or Prose+Flow bare tags) |

## Domain entry stack

| Term | Meaning | Prop / type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Statblock** | Creature / entity **entry** organism | `StatblockProps` |
| **name** | Creature title | `name`, `nameLevel` |
| **flavor** | Optional lead paragraph | `flavor` |
| **typeLine** | Size / type caption | `typeLine` |
| **vitals** | Combat vitals PropertyList (AbilityScoreGroup **header**) | `vitals: PropertyItem[]` |
| **abilities** | Ability columns | `abilities: AbilityScoreProps[]` |
| **details** | Skills, gear, senses, languages, CR (AbilityScoreGroup **footer**) | `details: PropertyItem[]` |
| **section** | Named block (Actions, Reactions, …) | `StatblockSectionProps.title` |
| **feature** | Named action / trait / reaction line | `StatblockFeatureProps` (`name`, `description`) |
| **AbilityScore** | One ability column (label + score + modifier + save) | `AbilityScoreProps` |
| **AbilityScoreGroup** | Sandwich organism (header + grid + footer) | `AbilityScoreGroupProps` |

Do **not** use **traits** for the footer PropertyList — that word collides with feature-style “traits” in rules prose. The footer rail is **`details`**.

## Core display terms

| Term | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| **Property** | One label → value pair (`dt` / `dd`) |
| **PropertyList** | Stacked properties (`dl`) — Core **molecule** |
| **ListItem** | One content-list row (`li`) |
| **List** | Stacked content items (`ul` / `ol`) — Core **molecule** (not PropertyList) |
| **Stat** | Numeric display chip (`disk` / `arch` / `shield`) |
| **emphasis** | Generic Stat highlight (thicker stroke, etc.) |
| **saveProficient** | Domain flag on AbilityScore; maps to Stat `emphasis` + AT suffix |

**Stat** (chip) and **Statblock** (entry) are different concepts that share a root word on purpose.

## Visible-string props

Use the prop that matches the role — do not force one name everywhere.

| Prop | Use for |
| --- | --- |
| `label` | Control/chrome copy and definition terms (Button, Badge, Property, AbilityScore header) |
| `text` | Typography primitives (Heading, Paragraph, Caption, ListItem, TableCell body) |
| `name` | Named entity (Statblock creature, StatblockFeature) |
| `title` | Section heading (StatblockSection) |
| `value` | Numeric or definitional payload (Stat, Property) |
| `description` | Feature body after the run-in name |
| `content` | HTML-only string body for composed hosts (e.g. Flow); React/Vue use `children` / slots |

In markup, a Property `label` is the definition **term** (`dt`). The prop name stays **`label`**.

## Variant vocabulary

| Surface | Prop | Values mean |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Button | `variant` | Action hierarchy: `primary` / `secondary` / `ghost` |
| Badge | `variant` | Surface recipe: `subtle` / `solid` / `outline` |
| Badge | `intent` | Feedback severity: `neutral` / `info` / `success` / `caution` / `critical` / `admin` |
| Heading / Paragraph / Caption / List | `tone` | Content weight: `primary` / `secondary` |
| List | `variant` | List kind: `unordered` / `ordered` |

`primary` is overloaded by design (control hierarchy vs content weight vs token slots). Prefer the table above over inventing parallel words.

Feedback uses **`caution`** / **`critical`** (not `warning` / `error`). Destructive actions use control **`destructive`** tokens / Button examples — that is separate from Badge intent.

## Type layers

| Package | Canonical type name |
| --- | --- |
| `@eevenkoto/core` | `*Props` + `*ClassNames()` |
| `@eevenkoto/html` | `*Props` (HTML-only extensions stay as local `*Props` that extend core) |
| `@eevenkoto/react` | `*ComponentProps` (DOM attrs + core props) |
| `@eevenkoto/vue` | `*Props` on the component |

Do not introduce `*Args` aliases.

## File-name conventions

| Surface | Convention | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Core TS sources | camelCase | `abilityScore.ts` |
| CSS / HTML folders & files | kebab-case | `ability-score/`, `primitive-tokens.css` |
| React / Vue / Storybook components | PascalCase | `AbilityScore.tsx` |
| BEM blocks | `eevenkoto-<block>` | `eevenkoto-ability-score` |
| camelCase props → BEM modifiers | kebab-case | `saveProficient` → `--save-proficient`, `runIn` → `--run-in` |

Public CSS import paths stay flat (`@eevenkoto/css/ability-score.css`) even when source lives under `core/` or `domain/`.

## Migration (0.1.x)

| Was | Use instead |
| --- | --- |
| `StatblockProps.traits` | `details` |
| HTML `*Args` (e.g. `ButtonArgs`) | `*Props` |
| Bare `StatblockFeature` / `StatblockSection` type aliases | `StatblockFeatureProps` / `StatblockSectionProps` |
| `primitivetokens.css` (legacy filename) | `primitive-tokens.css` |
| PropertyList under `core/atoms/` | `core/molecules/` |
| AbilityScoreGroup under `domain/molecules/` | `domain/organisms/` |
## Authoring composed components

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/foundations/authoring-composed-components.mdx`_

# Authoring composed components

Patterns learned while porting the Statblock stack (Property → Stat → AbilityScore → Statblock). Use this when adding **Domain organisms** that compose Core atoms and molecules — not when tweaking a single Core control like Button.

Also read: [Glossary](/?path=/docs/foundations-glossary--docs) · [Component taxonomy](/?path=/docs/foundations-component-taxonomy--docs) · [Packages](/?path=/docs/foundations-packages--docs) · [Minimum-class defaults](/?path=/docs/foundations-minimum-class-defaults--docs) · [Color Tokens — Architecture](/?path=/docs/foundations-color-tokens-architecture--docs) · [Tier 3 — Component Scoping](/?path=/docs/foundations-color-tokens-tier-3-component-scoping--docs)

## 1. Decide scope and hierarchy before the CSS

Place each piece on **Core vs Domain**, then map **atom → molecule → organism**. Keep English APIs; leave **product-language strings as data**. Canonical prop names (`details` vs features, `label` vs `text` vs `name`) are in the [Glossary](/?path=/docs/foundations-glossary--docs).

| Scope | Layer | Statblock example | Owns |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Core | Atom | Property, Stat, Heading, Frame, Scroll, TableCell | One semantic unit + BEM classes |
| Core | Molecule | PropertyList, Table | Layout of atoms + local ARIA |
| Core | Organism | TableShell | Slots composing Frame + Scroll + Table (+ future Pager) |
| Domain | Molecule | AbilityScore, StatblockFeature | Layout of Core atoms + local ARIA |
| Domain | Organism | AbilityScoreGroup, Statblock | Page-shaped composition, slots, outline |

**Do:** Ship a working Domain organism against a real specimen (e.g. Aatelinen), then extract molecules once the seams are obvious.

**Don’t:** Invent Heading/Paragraph “product variants” for organism chrome. Visual remaps belong on the **molecule/organism host** (section looks like meso H3; feature run-in looks like micro H6) while **element levels stay honest**. Domain must not leak into Core source folders.

## 2. Keep the accessibility tree honest

| Rule | Why it mattered |
| --- | --- |
| Contiguous heading outline | Legacy H1 → H3 → H6 looked fine visually and broke structure. Prefer H1 → H2 → H3; remap *look* in CSS on the host. |
| Real landmarks and lists | `article` / `section`, real `dl` / `dt` / `dd` for definitional metadata. Use the Core **Table** ecosystem (`TableCell` → `Table` → `TableShell`) for true tabular charts — not bold-label paragraphs. |
| Name the group | Prefer `figure` / `figcaption` for a named unit; still wire `id` + `aria-labelledby` on the inner `dl` when the caption alone does not name the list. |
| Decorative punctuation in CSS | Colons and run-in periods via `::after`, not baked into copy strings. |
| Embed-safe outline props | Hardcoding H1 is correct for a dedicated entry page and wrong under a docs chrome H1. Expose something like `nameLevel?: 1 \| 2` when the organism owns a title. |

Screen-reader-only text belongs on a shared utility (`.eevenkoto-visually-hidden` with `clip-path: inset(50%)`), not ad-hoc `clip: rect(...)`.

## 3. Emphasis is never color alone

Status and proficiency cues must survive CVD, low vision, and **forced colors**.

1. **Redundant channel** — thicker stroke, outline, pattern, or visible mark *plus* an AT-facing term (`Save (proficient)`).
2. **Measure contrast on the real surface** — gold that passes on `surface-raised` / canvas can fail **1.4.11 (3:1)** on `surface-sunken`. Audit the panel the chip actually sits on.
3. **Prefer a new Tier 1 stop** when chrome needs a darker/lighter pigment (`gold-primary-deep`) — do not invent brand accents with hue×hue `color-mix` in Tier 2 ([Tier 1 — Prefer a new primitive](/?path=/docs/foundations-color-tokens-tier-1-primitives--docs)).
4. **Forced-colors** — strip decorative shadows; map borders to system colors (`ButtonText`, `Highlight` for emphasis). Interactive Tier 3 already requires explicit borders; content chips need the same habit.

## 4. Package checklist (every new piece)

Follow the same seam as Button / Badge / Statblock:

1. **`@eevenkoto/core`** — props + `*ClassNames()` (no DOM).
2. **`@eevenkoto/css`** — Tier 3 file; private `--_eevenkoto-*` bridges; public `--eevenkoto-<component>-*` overrides only.
3. **`@eevenkoto/html`** — canonical `render*` + template (Storybook source of truth).
4. **`@eevenkoto/react` / `@eevenkoto/vue`** — thin wrappers; prefer `ReactNode` / slots for rich text.
5. **Storybook** — specimen story from real product copy + MDX with outline, a11y, and framework notes.

HTML string → DOM is a **trust boundary**. If the HTML package accepts inline markup, **sanitize to an allowlist** (`em`, `strong`, `i`, `b`, `br`, …) and escape everything else. Framework wrappers should take nodes, not raw HTML strings.

## 5. Quick pre-merge checklist

- [ ] Heading levels match the document role; visuals remapped on the host, not via fake levels
- [ ] Lists / labels / values are programmatically associated (`dl`, `aria-labelledby`, etc.)
- [ ] Status/emphasis has a non-color cue + AT text where needed
- [ ] Non-text contrast checked on **sunken and raised** backgrounds the component uses
- [ ] `forced-colors` and `prefers-reduced-motion` considered
- [ ] Organism titles that might embed under another H1 have an escape hatch (`nameLevel` or equivalent)
- [ ] HTML renderer escapes / sanitizes; React/Vue don’t reintroduce `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` by default
- [ ] Public API is English; locale strings stay in story / product data

## Reference specimen

[Statblock — Aatelinen](/?path=/docs/domain-organisms-statblock--docs) is the worked example: Core atoms (Property, Stat), Domain molecules (AbilityScore, StatblockFeature), Domain organisms (AbilityScoreGroup, Statblock), honest outline with visual remaps, proficiency emphasis, and embed `nameLevel`.
## Minimum-class defaults

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/foundations/minimum-class-defaults.mdx`_

# Minimum-class defaults

Every Tier 3 **host** (`.eevenkoto-<component>`) must look and behave as the **documented default** with no modifier classes. Modifiers are only for departing from that default. Framework `*ClassNames()` helpers may still emit explicit default aliases (`--primary`, `--md`, …) for a stable prop API.

Also read: [Tier 3 — Component Scoping](/?path=/docs/foundations-color-tokens-tier-3-component-scoping--docs) · [Typography](/?path=/docs/foundations-typography--docs) · [Packages](/?path=/docs/foundations-packages--docs) · [AGENTS.md](/AGENTS.md)

## Rules for authors

1. **Host = default.** Put the full default recipe (colors, size, interactive states, elevation) on `.eevenkoto-<block>`, via private-bridge fallbacks and host-level state selectors where needed.
2. **Modifiers are opt-in.** `--secondary`, `--sm`, `--solid`, etc. only change what is not already the default.
3. **Default modifier classes are aliases.** `--primary`, `--md`, `--subtle`, `--text`, `--stripe-row` may exist for helpers/docs but must not be *required* for the default look.
4. **Tag inference (type only).** Heading levels may come from `:where(hN).eevenkoto-heading` (zero tag specificity so `--M` still overrides). Do not use bare global `h1` / `p` / `button` selectors.
5. **Prose vs Flow.** Bare `h1`–`h6` / `p` / `ul` / `ol` / `li` get type styles only under `.eevenkoto-prose`. Vertical rhythm stays on `.eevenkoto-flow`. Compose: `eevenkoto-prose eevenkoto-flow`.
6. **Helpers may still be explicit.** Core can emit default modifiers so Button / Paragraph / List / Badge size props stay aligned; CSS must not depend on those classes for the default.

## Checklist when adding or changing a component

- [ ] `.eevenkoto-<block>` alone matches the Storybook default canvas
- [ ] Hover / focus / active / disabled for the default variant work without the default variant class
- [ ] Non-default variants fully override host defaults (no leaked primary hover, etc.)
- [ ] Docs show minimum markup (`class="eevenkoto-button"`, not only the fully expanded class list)
- [ ] If introducing “none” / opt-out (e.g. table stripe), emit an explicit modifier (`--stripe-none`) rather than relying on absence of a required default class

## Current defaults (hand-authored minimum)

| Host | Minimum markup | Default meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Heading | `<h2 class="eevenkoto-heading">` | Level from tag (`:where(hN)`); `--M` overrides |
| Paragraph | `<p class="eevenkoto-paragraph">` | `body-md` + primary |
| List | `<ul class="eevenkoto-list">` + bare `li` | unordered + `body-md` + primary (`ol` / `--ordered` for decimal); items via host descendants |
| Button | `<button class="eevenkoto-button">` | primary + md (full states) |
| Badge | `<span class="eevenkoto-badge">` | subtle + neutral + md + pill |
| Badge intent | `eevenkoto-badge eevenkoto-badge--success` | subtle + that intent |
| Badge surface | `eevenkoto-badge eevenkoto-badge--solid` | solid + neutral |
| Table | `<table class="eevenkoto-table">` | default variant + row stripe |
| TableCell | `<td class="eevenkoto-table-cell">` | text kind |
| Prose | `<div class="eevenkoto-prose">` + bare `h*` / `p` / `ul` / `ol` / `li` | same defaults as classed type |
| Flow | Compose with Prose for bare-tag pair gaps | classed primitives always |

## CSS patterns

### Host carries default tokens and states

```css
.eevenkoto-button {
  --_eevenkoto-button-text: var(
    --eevenkoto-button-text,
    var(--eevenkoto-color-control-primary-text)
  );
  /* … full primary + md fallbacks, including elevation … */
}

/* Default interactive states on the host; exclude non-default variants */
.eevenkoto-button:hover:not(.eevenkoto-button--secondary):not(.eevenkoto-button--ghost) {
  /* primary hover publics */
}

.eevenkoto-button--primary {
  /* optional explicit alias — same publics as host defaults */
}
```

### Tag maps with `:where` (Heading)

```css
:where(h1).eevenkoto-heading,
.eevenkoto-heading--1,
.eevenkoto-prose :where(h1) {
  /* level 1 publics */
}
```

`:where` keeps tag specificity at 0 so `.eevenkoto-heading--3` wins on `h1.eevenkoto-heading.eevenkoto-heading--3`.

### Intent / variant shortcuts (Badge)

Put the **default surface** recipe on intent-only classes; higher-specificity compounds cover non-default surfaces:

```css
.eevenkoto-badge--success { /* subtle success */ }
.eevenkoto-badge--solid { /* solid neutral */ }
.eevenkoto-badge--solid.eevenkoto-badge--success { /* solid success */ }
```

## Anti-patterns

- Requiring `--primary` / `--md` / `--subtle` / `--default` for the default look
- Putting default hover only on `.eevenkoto-button--primary:hover` so host-alone buttons look dead
- Bare `h1 { … }` or `button { … }` outside Prose / host compounds
- Treating Flow as a substitute for Prose (Flow owns gaps; Prose owns bare-tag type)
